name: Arcane (R)
author: qMystic
description: LDM ONLY: Land behind the spike at 43% to go under the cube portal. Enter the invisible normal size portal at 44% and go between the platform and gear. Hold to the ceiling at 45% (try to avoid the 2x speed portal to make the next part of the secret way easier). Stop holding at 46% when your wave goes behind the decoration to fall between the spikes. Hold at the ceiling from 46% to 81%. At 81% fall to the floor and stay there to the end.
